distribution.provenance: The small runtime artifacts were byte-compared with the canonical CohereLabs revision; the 4.13 GB weight has the same immutable Xet object identity and size upstream and in this distribution. The public distribution avoids placing Hugging Face credentials on the GB10.

limitations: The caller must select one of the 14 locked languages; the model does not auto-detect language.
The pinned vLLM Cohere decoder always enables punctuation; punctuation-off requests fail closed.
The model returns transcript text without timestamps or diarization; preprocessing and meeting-evidence modules own those capabilities.
The vLLM adapter accepts only mono signed-PCM16 WAV at 16 kHz after media admission and preprocessing.
The transport accepts the bounded four-hour envelope, but long-recording performance is not claimed until the end-to-end duration gate passes.
The eight-request continuous-batching profile is a GB10 candidate until the frozen representative latency, fairness, duration, and memory gate passes.

On the locked public fixture, the focused resident vLLM service matched the exact Transformers reference transcript hash with zero normalized word errors; punctuation still differs from the human golden and representative-corpus parity remains incomplete.

A non-gate dirty-head GB10 probe verified exact readiness, independent c2/c4/c8 requests, an engine-active cancellation acknowledged in 18 milliseconds, vLLM engine-abort logging and return to zero running requests, no cancelled-result publication, immediate recovery, 3.09 GiB observed container memory, and complete container/loopback teardown. This is development evidence, not promotion or production capacity.

Focused exact-duration controls completed a 30-second c2 wave plus c1 2-minute, 15-minute, 2-hour, and exact 4-hour inputs. The 4-hour repeated-fixture control completed in 49.896 seconds with 4.272 GiB current container usage and clean teardown. Repetition makes this duration/lifecycle evidence only; sentinel integrity, natural long-form quality, frozen percentiles, and promotion remain open.
